about: Local release conveyor belt, driven by `cargo xtask release` (xtask/src/release.rs). Each step says what to do; `done` runs its checks before moving on. {version} is replaced by the release version. Progress lives in log/release/state.json (not committed).

steps.title: Set the version
do: Make sure the work for this release is merged into main and checked out.
Set the version: `cargo xtask version set {version}` (updates Cargo.toml and Cargo.lock).

steps.title: Commit and push the version bump
do: Commit Cargo.toml and Cargo.lock: `git commit -am "Prism {version}"`.
Push main.

steps.title: Build the macOS packages
do: RustRover: run "Prism Package (macOS)" (Apple silicon only), or for Apple silicon + Intel: `rustup target add x86_64-apple-darwin` once, then `packaging/macos/package.sh --arch universal`.

With a Developer ID set (MACOS_SIGN_IDENTITY, APPLE_ID, APPLE_PASSWORD, APPLE_TEAM_ID) the app is signed and notarized; without, it is ad-hoc signed (fine for in-app updates, blocked by Gatekeeper when downloaded from the web).
Output: dist/release/prism-{version}-macos-<arch>.dmg and .app.zip.

steps.title: Try the built app
do: Open dist/release/prism-{version}-macos-*.dmg, drag Prism to Applications, launch it.
Help › About Prism shows {version}. Open a PSD, paint a stroke, save a copy, quit.

steps.title: Build the Windows installer
do: On a Windows PC with this commit: `pwsh packaging/windows/package.ps1 -Arch x64`.
Copy dist/release/prism-{version}-windows-x64.msi into this Mac's dist/release/.
Skip this step (`cargo xtask release skip`) to ship macOS only.

steps.title: Tag the release
do: `git tag v{version}` on the version commit, then `git push origin v{version}`.

steps.title: Upload the installers
do: Put the .dmg (and .msi) where people download Prism, for example a GitHub Release:
`GH_TOKEN=$(gh auth token --user NK-Studio) gh release create v{version} --repo NK-Studio/prism --title "Prism v{version}" dist/release/prism-{version}-*.dmg dist/release/prism-cli-{version}-*.zip`
Skip if installers are shared another way.

verify.run: GH_TOKEN=$(gh auth token --user NK-Studio 2>/dev/null) gh release view v{version} --repo NK-Studio/prism --json tagName

steps.title: Publish the in-app update
do: RustRover: run "Prism Publish Update (dry run)" and check the printed feed, then run "Prism Publish Update".
Terminal: `packaging/publish-update.sh` (add `--min-supported X.Y.Z` to send older versions to a manual download).
It signs the feed with ~/prism-update.key, pushes NK-Studio/prism-updates and waits until Vercel serves {version}.

steps.title: Check the update reaches users
do: On a Mac with the previous Prism (one that has in-app updates): Help › Check for Updates… finds {version}.
Update → Restart to Update; Prism reopens and Help › About Prism shows {version}.
Skip for the first release with in-app updates: no installed copy can update yet.
